title: Experimental packaging: tiered observability retention + compliance pack + premium SLA gating
creator: Marco Silva
description:
Summary:
Run an experiment to validate demand and implementation boundaries for three add-ons: (1) extended observability retention (30/90/365 days tiers), (2) Compliance Pack (audit logs + formalized retention + KMS/HSM integrations), and (3) Premium SLA (99.95% with on-call escalation + faster eviction/fallback policies). Goal is to (a) identify willingness-to-pay bands, (b) test feature-gating and billing mechanics, and (c) capture legal/security implications for enterprise contracts and questionnaires.

Background & motivation:
- Feedback from sales/CS shows frequent asks for longer log/trace retention and compliance artifacts during RFPs.
- Dedicated/Private customers expect configurable SLAs and contractual remedies.
- We lack a standardized add-on gating model that ties console feature flags, billing meter, and contract clauses.

Experiment hypothesis:
1) 20–30% of mid-market and enterprise trials will opt into a 90-day observability retention for a ~15–25% uplift in monthly bill.
2) The Compliance Pack will be purchased by >=10% of inbound RFP leads when presented as a line-item with clear artifacts (audit trail, KMS integration, compliance report).
3) Premium SLA will convert ~5% of high-usage customers willing to commit to reserved capacity for predictable performance.

Success metrics (primary):
- Conversion rate to each add-on within 90 days of availability
- ARPA uplift attributable to add-ons
- Net new bookings where Compliance Pack was a gating factor for deal closure
- Support/ops incidents tied to new tiers (should not increase >10%)

Secondary metrics:
- Time-to-acceptance for contractual QA items (security questionnaire turnaround)
- Number of legal exceptions requested for SLAs

Scope & trade-offs:
- Minimal viable product: front-end gating (console + API flag) + billing SKU + basic backend retention toggle for observability indices. No initial full-featured KMS integration for MVP (we will ship a documented manual workflow and prioritize engineering work if demand meets threshold).
- Compliance Pack MVP: audit log export + formalized retention policy + downloadable compliance package (PDF). KMS/HSM integration will be sold as a roadmap item (phase 2).
- Premium SLA MVP: contract template + product-side priority routing and monitoring. Do not promise financial credits in MVP; offer operational commitments and fast-path support.
- Trade-offs: faster time-to-market vs. partial functionality for KMS and formal SLAs; risk of confusing customers if packaging is unclear.

Implementation notes (engineering & billing):
- Backend: Add observability_retention_days configuration per customer (30/90/365). ENG-6281 owns data lifecycle implementation and cost accounting.
- Billing: new SKUs for each tier to be added to usage engine; billing team owns pricing table.
- Feature flags: gate via existing flag service; console toggles will be visible only to org admins.
- API: add optional parameters to org settings endpoint to opt into add-ons.

Console & UX considerations (DES feedback):
- Design mockups in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Design-Addons-2026 (see mockups v2).
- Key UX priorities: clear summary of incremental cost, sample invoices, and an inline compliance artifacts checklist.
- Accessibility: ensure retention selector provides clear implications for cost and egress.

Security & legal questionnaire implications:
- Common SSQ asks expected: data residency, log retention duration, KMS/HSM support, encryption in transit/at rest, audit log access controls. Create canonical answers and evidence files.
- Draft answers and artifacts stored: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Compliance-Pack-FAQ
- Legal to review SLA language for premium offering. Priya Nair (Legal) assigned to final contract addendum draft.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 0 (2 weeks): internal alpha for sales engineering + CS with 5 pilot customers.
- Phase 1 (4 weeks): closed beta for 30 customers with instrumentation.
- Phase 2 (8 weeks): public opt-in release in console with marketing collateral.

Instrumentation & dashboards:
- Experiment dashboard: https://redwood.company/dashboards/addons-experiment (KPIs, conversion, MRR impact).
- Track events: addon_viewed, addon_opted_in, addon_opted_out, qa_submitted, contract_exception_requested. ENG analytics to implement event schema.

Open questions & risks:
- Pricing bands: do we use multiplicative uplift vs flat fee? Initial proposal: flat monthly fee for observability tiers and a one-time Compliance Pack onboarding fee.
- Billing edge cases: retroactive refunds when downgrade occurs mid-billing cycle. Require billing team decision.
- Security: customers may require proof-of-KMS integration before buying Compliance Pack; deferred integration could block sales.
